why: Both moved the same two code paths with comparable care and honesty, but B's system-level work is on a different level: it found the largest cost item in the product (page/document context pinned to the last message, which defeats prompt caching) with measured savings, questioned whether calls should exist at all (killing the first-turn web-search rewrite and image tokens on a text-query call), moved utility calls to cheap models, fixed a reasoning-effort setting that never reached the wire, and reasoned Router as a user-selectable provider through the surface Router actually serves. A's judgment stops at a provider timeout and a tier pin, and its one proposal routes Router through the Anthropic Messages client even though its own runtime already translates Chat Completions onto /v1/responses.
A_best: A disciplined, well-scoped migration: one wrap at the single shared OpenAI client covers every OpenAI-compatible provider while leaving Ollama/Chrome/Gemini byte-identical, with per-feature labels and the tier pin landed in the migration itself, and unusually honest notes on the build-time key shifting who pays and on thinking-enabled Claude chats deliberately staying off Router.
B_best: The caching rework (i5): it correctly diagnoses that `systemPrompt.replace("{context}",…)` puts a 5k-50k-token page at the end of the prompt so nothing cacheable precedes it, quantifies the loss with Router's own -90%/-49% measurements, points at the web-search mode as the in-repo reference shape, and names the real blocker — user-editable prompt templates — so it is proposed with a one-mode rollout rather than quietly committed.
A_worst: The system-level judgment is thin for the bar: two improvement items total, no model-tiering for the mechanical rewrite/title calls, no fallbacks or caps, no question of whether any call should exist, and it adds a prompt_cache_key while missing that this app's prompts have no stable cacheable prefix to key on — so the caching claim is close to inert.
B_worst: Delivery hygiene lags the thinking: the labels and per-feature policy that everything else depends on sit on a branch rather than in the migration (live traffic still arrives as `src/models/CustomChatOpenAI.ts:<module>`), 15 of the 21 claimed routed sites are unverified by the outside check, and the vendored runtime was hand-edited in two places.
